texts.name: Page Subtitle
texts.text: Production asset contract for the public package. Documentation + production-asset audit only — nothing exported, no approved component changed.

texts.name: 1 · Core package principle — Body
texts.text:
Cards are composed at runtime from reusable primitives — never shipped as pre-rendered card files.
Shared geometry (shell, corners, pip layouts, rotations, scaling) is package code; only artwork and reusable shapes ship as SVG.

<Card rank="K" suit="hearts" style="western" />  assembles:
   shared card shell + shared corner geometry + ranks/k.svg + suits/heart.svg + courts/western/king.svg
   — NOT western-king-of-hearts.svg

DO NOT PRODUCE: 52 separate front SVGs, nor 52 × 3 style SVGs. Dynamic composition is a central architectural decision.
A court artwork is suit-neutral: one King artwork per style serves all four suits.

texts.name: 11 · Rank font dependency (Hanuman) — Body
texts.text:
Font-based in Penpot (live text):  2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 A  (red + black components)  ·  J Q K  (text inside face-card masters)
                                   Joker Index  (Hanuman 700)
Vector already:                    10  (custom glyph — keep visually unchanged)

Penpot MCP test: penpot.flatten() on a detached copy of 'A' returned only the text-box rectangle (no glyph outlines).
→ Text cannot be safely outlined through the MCP. No rank component was modified.
Penpot SVG markup of a rank emits <text font-family:Hanuman> → external-font dependency if exported as is.

Decision: outline the glyphs during export/build (e.g. fontTools / opentype.js) from Hanuman Regular (400) and Bold (700),
reproducing the exact Penpot parameters in §6, then verify against Penpot PNG exports (pixel diff).
Hanuman is SIL Open Font License 1.1 — outlining/embedding permitted; include the licence notice in the package.
Distribution SVGs must contain paths only — no <text>, no font-family, no webfont loading.

texts.name: 12 · Export requirements (every standalone SVG) — Body
texts.text:
• valid SVG 1.1, deterministic viewBox at the asset frame origin: suits 0 0 30 37.5 · ranks 0 0 40 50 · courts 0 0 140 210
  jokers 0 0 120 198 · backs 0 0 250 350 · aces/spade 0 0 93.66 117.075
• no width/height attributes that block scaling (viewBox only; package sets size)
• transparent background (all except backs/classic, which is a complete card)
• no raster images · no base64 · no external references · no external fonts (paths only)
• no filters unless explicitly approved (none needed today)
• no editor metadata / ids / Penpot wrapper groups; optimised path data
• single-colour assets (suits, ranks) use currentColor; artwork keeps its baked palette
Penpot's raw markup is NOT distribution-ready: page-coordinate viewBox, frame wrappers, duplicated fill/stroke groups —
court art measures 1.6–3.2 MB per file in raw markup. Normalise + optimise in the build step.

texts.name: 13 · Source vs distribution — Body
texts.text:
SOURCE        high-fidelity SVGs exported from Penpot; visually authoritative; never optimised destructively;
              Penpot components stay the master (no in-Penpot path simplification).
DISTRIBUTION  build output shipped with the package: viewBox-normalised, glyphs outlined, SVGO-optimised
              (path precision, merge, strip metadata) — must pass a visual diff against SOURCE.
Old imports on 99 — Imports are kept (labelled UNUSED / SOURCE) until the export pipeline is validated.

texts.name: Page Subtitle
texts.text: One shared, data-driven chip geometry (64 × 64). Value, label and colours are configurable; stacks repeat the same chip. Independent of card styles and the card back.

texts.name: Notes Body
texts.text:
GEOMETRY  (canonical 64 × 64, viewBox 0 0 64 64, centre 32,32; everything scales by size/64)
  Outer Edge     circle r 32          fill chip-base · stroke 1 px inner, #000000 @ 0.28 (chip-outline)
  Edge Inserts   8 annular sectors    r 24.5 → 32 (depth 7.5) · sweep 18° · spacing 45° · first centred at −90° (top)
                 sector i: θ = −90° + 45°·i, from θ−9° to θ+9° — one shape rotated 8× about (32,32)
                 outer chord ≈ 10.0, inner chord ≈ 7.7 · fill chip-edge-insert
  (base band)    r 22.5 → 24.5 shows chip-base between inserts and ring
  Inner Ring     circle r 22.5 under Center Field → 2 px ring (r 20.5–22.5) · fill chip-inner-ring
  Center Field   circle r 20.5        fill chip-center
  Label          live text, centred on (32,32); box 40 × 24 at (12,20)
  Paint order    Outer Edge → Edge Inserts → Inner Ring → Center Field → Label

TYPOGRAPHY  (design reference — implementation may use an equivalent package/UI font)
  Inter Tight 800 · 16 px at 64 · line-height 1 · letter-spacing 0 · align centre/centre
  ≤ 3 characters at 16 px (≈ 33 px wide in a 41 px field); longer labels shrink to fit 34 px width.
  Rendered at runtime as text — no chip font asset, not converted to paths.

COLOUR ROLES  chip-base · chip-edge-insert · chip-inner-ring (= insert by default) · chip-center (= base by default)
              chip-label · chip-outline (#000000 @ 0.28)
Classic theme (package default only — NOT a universal casino standard; fully customisable):
  value  base      insert/ring  label     label contrast
  1      #F2EFE6   #1F4E9C      #1F2937   12.8 : 1
  5      #C62828   #F4F1EA      #FFFFFF    5.6 : 1
  25     #2E7D32   #F4F1EA      #FFFFFF    5.1 : 1
  100    #1E1F22   #F4F1EA      #FFFFFF   16.5 : 1
  500    #6A3FA0   #F4F1EA      #FFFFFF    7.4 : 1
  1K     #E3B23C   #1E1F22      #1F2937    7.5 : 1
  5K     #7A4A2A   #F4F1EA      #FFFFFF    7.4 : 1
  custom #0C7A7C   #F4F1EA      #FFFFFF    5.1 : 1   (250 — colour independent of value)

SCALE (proportional)   64 Excellent · 48 Excellent · 40 Good · 32 Good · 24 Marginal · 16 Poor
  Smallest Excellent 48 · smallest Good 32 · recommended minimum 32 × 32 (denomination readable)
  Technically renderable 16 × 16 (chip + colour recognisable; label unreadable).
  Fails first: label (4–6 px) → inner ring (≤ 0.75 px) → outline; edge inserts survive longest.

STACKS (Poker / Chip Stack = top-down overlapping Chip instances, data-driven) — see Perspective Test below
  offset +3 x / −4 y per chip at 64 · bounds (64 + 3(n−1)) × (64 + 4(n−1)) · 5 chips → 76 × 80
  order bottom → top (bottom chip at left/low, top chip painted last, label fully visible)
  visible cap 5–8, default 5; larger counts cap visually and keep the numeric value separately
  top-down only: no side walls, perspective or thickness. Shadow optional: variant Shadow = None | Subtle (presentation styling).
  Totals (e.g. 1,300) are UI text outside the chips — never baked into chip graphics.

EXPORT MODEL   standalone chip SVG assets required: 0
  generated from 4 circles + 8 sector paths + 1 text → small bundle, custom colours/values, deterministic scaling
  not counted in the playing-card export asset matrix.

PROPOSED API (conceptual — no code yet)
  <Chip value={25} />            <Chip value={100} label="100" />      <Chip value={1000} label="1K" />
  <Chip value={250} color="#0C7A7C" />
  <ChipStack value={100} count={5} />
  <ChipStack chips={[{ value: 100, count: 3 }, { value: 500, count: 2 }]} />

texts.name: Stack Test Caption
texts.text:
Top-down overlapping Chip instances · +3 px x / −4 px y per chip at 64 · bottom chip painted first
Poker / Chip Stack variants: Shadow = None | Subtle (0, 2, blur 2.5, #000 @ 18%). Scale-check rows: A = None, B = Subtle.

texts.name: Decision Body
texts.text:
DECISION (approved):  top-down stack · offset +3 px x / −4 px y per chip at 64 · subtle shadow, OPTIONAL

Approved visual language:  Top-down (overlapping circular Chip instances, bottom painted first, top chip label fully visible)
Rejected:                  Pseudo-3D side-wall stack (previous 6 px vertical offset) · +6/−8 alternative (larger footprint)

Geometry:  5-chip bounds 76 × 80 · total displacement x +12, y −16 · bounds = (64 + 3(n−1)) × (64 + 4(n−1)); scales with size/64
Shadow:    optional presentation styling — Poker / Chip Stack variant property Shadow = None | Subtle
           Subtle = drop shadow per chip: offset 0, 2 · blur 2.5 · spread 0 · #000000 @ 18% (scale offset/blur with size)
           never part of the base Chip geometry/SVG; Poker / Chip itself has no shadow.

Findings:  dark felt — None: identical black chips merge; Subtle: every layer separates, not muddy.
           light page — both read; Subtle adds gentle depth without floating.
           48 / 32 px — overlap and shadow scale proportionally; crescents ≈2.5 px at 32 (Subtle helps most here).

Visible-chip cap:  recommended 5–8 · package default 5. Larger real counts cap the visual stack and keep the
   numeric count/value separately (label outside). Never render dozens of individual chips.

Proposed API:  <ChipStack value={100} count={5} />                 // default: subtle shadow on
               <ChipStack value={100} count={5} shadow={false} />   // flat, no shadow
               <ChipStack chips={[{ value: 100, count: 3 }, { value: 500, count: 2 }]} />

texts.name: Markers Caption

texts.name: Marker Notes Body
texts.text:
GEOMETRY  (canonical 64 × 64, viewBox 0 0 64 64, centre 32,32; scales by size/64)
  Outer Disc     circle r 32    fill marker-background · stroke 2.5 inner marker-border
  Inner Border   circle r 26    no fill · stroke 2 centre marker-accent
  Center Field   circle r 25    fill marker-field
  Label          live text centred on (32,32); box 48 × 32 at (8,16)
  Paint order    Outer Disc → Inner Border → Center Field → Label
  No edge inserts, no stripes, single ring → reads as a position token, not money.

COLOUR ROLES (configurable; independent of court styles, chips, card back)
  marker-background #F4F1EA · marker-field #FAF8F3 · marker-border #22201E · marker-label #22201E
  marker-accent: dealer #22201E · small-blind #2F6DB5 · big-blind #C27C0E

TYPOGRAPHY  Inter Tight 800 (reference; package may use an equivalent UI font), line-height 1, centred
  Dealer 'D' 28 px · 'SB' / 'BB' 20 px at 64 (balanced visual weight)

SCALE   D: 64–32 Excellent · 24 Good · 16 Marginal     SB/BB: 64–40 Excellent · 32 Good · 24 Marginal · 16 Poor
  Smallest Excellent 40 · smallest Good 32 · recommended minimum 32 × 32 (24 acceptable for Dealer only)
  Fails first: SB/BB letters → accent ring (faint at 24) → dark rim survives longest.

TABLE   render size 40 × 40 on the canonical 1000 px table (= 0.04 × table width) — clearly distinct from 32 px chips
  Placement (approved): M = S + 125·I + 55·lateralSign·T · I = normalize(C − S) · T = (I.y, −I.x) clockwise tangent
  lateralSign stored per seat (2/6/8/9 tables on 16 — Poker Table) · same function for dealer, small blind, big blind
  validated collision-free in all layouts, minimum clearance 14.1 px

EXPORT  standalone marker SVG assets: 0 — generated from 3 circles + 1 text
API     <PokerMarker type="dealer" />  <PokerMarker type="small-blind" />  <PokerMarker type="big-blind" />

texts.text: Approved placement: M = S + 125·I + 55·lateralSign·T (T = clockwise tangent) · clear of cards, bets, pot, seats (≥ 14 px, all layouts)

texts.name: Marker Placement Body
texts.text:
Given table centre C = (500, 300) and seat anchor S (canonical 1000 × 600):
  I = normalize(C − S)                 unit inward vector
  T = (I.y, −I.x)                      clockwise tangent in screen space (y down) — points toward the next seat index
  M = S + I · 125 + T · (55 · lateralSign)
  lateralSign +1 = clockwise (toward seat i+1) · −1 = counter-clockwise (toward seat i−1)
  Marker render size 40 × 40 (Poker / Marker scaled from 64). Same function for dealer, small blind, big blind.
  Signs are stored per seat (deterministic) — never inferred at runtime.
